title: The Forgotten Choir
author: Rosalind Galloway
blurb: Mirabel Yarrow, a cartographer of unmapped realms, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
